Implemented typed-edge schema for memory relationships. Created MemoryRelationshipEdge record with closed vocabulary (References, Supersedes, SupersededBy, DependsOn, ConflictsWith, Mentions, LinksTo, SameAs) and EdgeOrigin enum (Manual, Inferred, Imported). Added additive Relationships list to MemoryRecord alongside existing References/Conflicts for backward compatibility. Added 4 tests: default Relationships list, backward compat survival, Create helper defaults, and all RelationTypes coverage. 215/221 tests passing.

Implemented flexible branding: added BrandingOptions (ShortLabel, LogoUrl, FaviconUrl) to MemorySmithOptions; updated MainLayout.razor to display logo, dynamic favicon via HeadContent, and ShortLabel in nav drawer; added memorysmith-instance meta tag for JS consumption; replaced hardcoded JS routeTitleFallbacks with dynamic buildRouteTitleFallback reading the meta tag; added .app-logo CSS; updated Chat.razor aria-label to use InstanceName. 0 build errors, 215/221 tests passing.
